title: Tech Stack, CDN & SSL Certificate Lookup

urls.title: URLs / domains
urls.description: List of domains or URLs to look up. Bare domains (example.com) are accepted as-is.

startUrls.title: Start URLs (alias of urls)
startUrls.description: Alias of 'urls' for compatibility with tools that use this field name. Accepts plain strings or {"url": "..."} objects.

domains.title: Domains (alias of urls)
domains.description: Alias of 'urls' for compatibility with tools that use this field name.

websites.title: Websites (alias of urls)
websites.description: Alias of 'urls' for compatibility with tools that use this field name.

targetUrls.title: Target URLs (alias of urls)
targetUrls.description: Alias of 'urls' for compatibility with tools that use this field name.

url.title: Single URL (alias of urls)
url.description: Alias of 'urls' for a single domain/URL.

categories_filter.title: Category filter
categories_filter.description: Only report detected technologies in these categories (e.g. "CMS", "Analytics"). Leave empty to report every category.

include_versions.title: Include detected versions
include_versions.description: Include the detected version number for each technology, when one was found.

include_confidence.title: Include confidence score
include_confidence.description: Include a confidence score (0-100) for each detected technology.

timeout_seconds.title: Per-domain timeout (seconds)
timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for each domain's page to load before giving up. Clamped to 3-60.
